sentences.en: What should my daily intake of calories be?
sentences.zh: 我每天应该摄入多少卡路里？

sentences.en: After his heart attack, Jim had to cut down on his sugar intake.
sentences.zh: 心脏病发作后，吉姆不得不减少糖分摄入。

sentences.en: Sami filled out the intake form.

senses.zh: (水管、煤气管等的)入口, 进口, 通风口, (在一定期间的)引入的量。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：in（进入）+take（带来）→被带入里面→吸入，纳入
